# `gno.land/r/moul/bertydao/v1`

**Archived placeholder — there is no realm here yet.**

Imported from [moul/berty-dao.gno](https://github.com/moul/berty-dao.gno), whose
only gno source is a 17-byte `package bertydao` with no declarations. The import
was faithful; the upstream project was never written.

Marked `ignore = true` in `gnomod.toml` so the toolchain skips it and it is
neither catalogued nor published as an empty on-chain realm. If the Berty DAO
gets implemented upstream, drop the `ignore` line and re-import.
